Title: Mariana Gilbert Does anyone out there know if this card has been issued yet. If it has how do you get it. I was told it was a book card like Dan Murdock but when I contact White Wolf or WoTC no one seems to know.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
The book containing Mariana Gilbert (and the coupon for the card) should
be out from HarperCollins in a month or two.
